Pooja’s housemaid Lakshmi tells her that she would take leave from her work on the day of ‘Raksha Bandhan’. Pooja refuses to grant leave to Lakshmi. Mr. Gupta plans to go to his sister’s house to celebrate ‘Raksha Bandhan’.
